summary: Strengthen operating controls, safeguard assurance and process safety reporting. Explore the five-day course and its practical curriculum.
lede: Oil and gas process safety management coordinates controls for hazards that can cause major incidents in process facilities. For operations, maintenance and process safety professionals, the course develops practical ways to review safe operating limits, verify safeguard status and track process safety indicators through operating records, audit evidence and action follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who oversee or execute process safety controls in oil and gas facilities, including those who need to connect operating records with safeguard assurance and management reporting.
audience: Oil and Gas Process Safety Engineers
modules: Process Safety Competence and Human Factors
prerequisites: Working knowledge of oil and gas operations or process safety responsibilities is expected. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with spreadsheets is useful for KPI exercises but is not essential.
